name: DiffNeRF Curvature Regularization
aliases: Regularization of NeRFs using differential geometry
definition: A regularization technique for neural implicit surfaces (specifically VolSDF) that uses Gaussian curvature (γ_gauss) and mean curvature (γ_mean) to directly regularize the surface geometry during training, rather than regularizing projections or depth maps.
summary: DiffNeRF Curvature Regularization penalizes Gaussian and Mean curvatures of implicit surfaces during training, distinguishing itself by operating directly on the function's differential geometry rather than projections.
